scripts.test-graph:render: bash -c 'VENV=.venv-test-graph; [ -d $VENV ] || uv venv $VENV; $VENV/bin/python -c "import svgwrite" >/dev/null 2>&1 || uv pip install --python $VENV/bin/python svgwrite -q; $VENV/bin/python scripts/render-test-graph.py'
scripts.extract-routes: bash -c 'VENV=.venv-extract; [ -d $VENV ] || (uv venv $VENV && $VENV/bin/python -m pip install osmium -q); $VENV/bin/python scripts/extract_bicycle_routes.py data/czech-republic-latest.osm.pbf data/cycleroutes.geojson'
scripts.import-pois: bash -c 'VENV=.venv-extract; [ -d $VENV ] || (uv venv $VENV && $VENV/bin/python -m pip install osmium -q); $VENV/bin/python scripts/import-pois.py data/czech-republic-latest.osm.pbf data/cz-pois.sqlite'
